title: Mona and the Daisy Sneeze
synopsis: A friendly dragon sneezes daisies into a picnic; her friends find the flowers very funny.

related_resources.reason: Playful fiction offers a familiar frame for imagination; this whimsical sneeze was not evaluated.
Age-three guidance includes simple counting and story conversation; no effect from a daisy plot is established.

rationale_citations.editorial_rationale: The impossible flower-sneeze introduces playful surprise rather than a moral.
rationale_citations.evidence_scope: Parent/caregiver guidance supports only broad age-appropriate editorial practices. It does not assess this original story or prove any cognitive, behavioral or sleep outcome.
